  • Ability to debug real code, find the root cause of issues, and fix them cleanly.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a mid-level, versatile Software Engineer to work across our platform's front-end and back-end systems. This role will contribute to our security safeguard capabilities, GraphQL interfaces, and front-end systems — which may include internal tools and/or our customer-facing portal. This is a good fit for someone comfortable moving between the front end and back end, with solid experience in at least one cloud platform and an interest in API and interface design.

Work Mode

Remote

Shift Timings

Monday to Friday, 2:00pm to 11:30pm IST

Location

Mumbai — Remote

Responsibilities & Duties

Front-End & Back-End Development

  • Design, build, and maintain features across both front-end and back-end systems, depending on current team priorities.
  • Develop and maintain front-end functionality for internal tools and our customer-facing portal, primarily addressing bugs and enhancements today, with the opportunity to contribute to a future portal redesign.
  • Build and support GraphQL interfaces and other API/interface layers used across the platform.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve defects across the stack, working with teammates to identify root causes.
  • Participate in code reviews and follow established coding standards and best practices.

Platform, Cloud & Security

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of security safeguard capabilities across our cloud environments.
  • Support and troubleshoot services running in cloud environments, including containerized workloads.
  • Follow established data-handling standards when working with sensitive data.

Collaborate with onshore and offshore team members across time zones, including regular participation in team standups.

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3–5+ years of professional software development experience across front-end and back-end work.
  • Working proficiency with at least one modern front-end framework and one back-end language/framework.
  • Experience with at least one major public cloud platform — AWS, Azure, etc.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals: data structures, APIs, testing, and version control.
  • Ability to work independently on assigned features while collaborating well with a distributed team.
  • Comfort incorporating AI-assisted coding tools into daily development work.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills for cross-team, cross-timezone collaboration.

Good to Have

  • Experience with GraphQL or other modern API/interface technologies.
  • Experience building security or compliance-related features in a cloud environment.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, and/or GCP).
  • Experience contributing to a customer-facing product or portal.
  • Familiarity with container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).
  • Experience setting up or working with agentic AI coding pipelines.

Soft Skills / Behavioural Skills

Excellent communication skills (written & verbal) Working independently Critical thinking

Benefits

  • Annual public holidays as applicable
  • 30 days total leave per calendar year
  • Mediclaim policy
  • Lifestyle Rewards Program
  • Group Term Life Insurance
  • Gratuity
  • …and more!

jobs.title: Full-Stack Website Developer
jobs.excerpt: Productsup is a Berlin-based company with a strong international customer base, and we’re looking to rapidly scale our reach within the digital commerce landscape.
jobs.description:
Productsup is a Berlin-based company with a strong international customer base, and we’re looking to rapidly scale our reach within the digital commerce landscape. We are seeking a high-performing Full-Stack Website Developer to join our dynamic Marketing team. In this pivotal role, you will own our website strategy end-to-end, ensuring our site is continuously optimized for conversion and driving performance from foundational back-end architecture to high-impact front-end user experiences.

Key Responsibilities
Technical Engineering & Architecture
  • Back-End (Headless CMS): Design, scale, and maintain Contentful content models, fields, spaces, and environments. Oversee structured content delivery using GraphQL/REST API queries, webhooks, and modern data-handling protocols.
  • Front-End (Presentation Layer): Build and maintain responsive, accessible, secure, and performant web experiences using modern JavaScript frameworks (Nuxt.js, Vue.js, Node.js) alongside semantic HTML5 and advanced CSS3.
  • Integrations & DevOps: Connect Contentful seamlessly with critical third-party tools, including CRM platforms (HubSpot), web analytics solutions, and cloud infrastructure/hosting environments (AWS, Amazon CloudFront, S3, Heroku).
  • AI & Workflow Automation: Enhance, scale, and maintain internal AI-powered automation tools, leveraging platforms such as OpenAI to streamline recurring web workflows, reduce manual operational overhead, and boost overall team efficiency.
Analytics, Tracking & Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Performance Monitoring: Evaluate end-to-end site health, user engagement, and marketing funnel performance using GA4, Hotjar, and advanced data visualization tools.
  • CRO Pipeline Ownership: Own the testing pipeline by designing (with copy and design support) and executing rigorous A/B and multivariate tests across copy, interactive layouts, and visual CTAs to maximize lead conversion rates.
  • Funnel Optimization: Proactively monitor critical site metrics—including Conversion Rate (CVR), bounce rates, and form drop-off trends—to identify conversion friction and engineer immediate solutions.
  • Data Integrity & Tagging: Deploy and manage precise event tracking arrays using Google Tag Manager (GTM) and GA4. Conduct thorough QA on all new pages to guarantee exact tag firing, conversion pixel accuracy, and clean UTM parameters.
  • Data Flow Architecture: Partner closely with Marketing Operations to secure seamless data flows from web touchpoints into CRMs, data platforms, and executive reporting dashboards.
CMS Enablement, SEO & Support
  • CMS Training & Enablement: Design and deliver comprehensive CMS onboarding and training sessions for new and existing internal website users.
  • Contributor Guidance: Act as the primary technical point of contact for website-related issues, providing continuous documentation, troubleshooting support, and governance for content contributors.
  • Publishing Best Practices: Champion best-in-class workflows for web publishing, ensuring content layout consistency, cross-browser compatibility, and digital asset efficiency.
  • Technical SEO: Implement foundational and advanced technical SEO requirements in collaboration with the SEO Manager to preserve and improve organic search visibility, site indexation, and page speed performance.

What You Bring to the Team
  • Technical Background: Proven experience building performant, robust, responsive, and cross-browser compatible Server-Side Rendering (SSR) websites.
  • Framework Mastery: Hands-on experience with JavaScript frameworks (specifically Nuxt.js, Vue.js, and Node.js) alongside core HTML5 and CSS3.
  • Headless CMS & APIs: Direct experience configuring, managing, and querying headless CMS environments (Contentful strongly preferred), with a fluent understanding of HTTP, JSON, REST, and GraphQL.
  • Cloud & DevOps: Competency in managing deployments and environments within cloud services (AWS, S3, Amazon CloudFront), Heroku, and modern version control/project tracking tools (Git, Jira).
  • Work Experience: 5+ years of digital operations experience, with at least 1–2 years specifically managing content inside a headless CMS environment.
  • Professional Competencies: Strong data-driven mindset, excellent relationship-building skills across design and marketing teams, and the ability to troubleshoot critical bugs under pressure with high autonomy.

What We Offer You
  • A permanent position with an attractive salary at our growing company
  • The option to work remotely and flexibly, because we know outstanding talent knows best how and where to work
  • A unique and thorough onboarding program where you’ll learn the ins-and-outs of our company and product
  • Ongoing internal and external training, plus a yearly learning budget to help you continuously grow professionally and further your career with Productsup
  • Opportunities for engaging in our Corporate Social Responsibility initiatives, plus one paid Impact Day per year dedicated to voluntary work
  • Employee referral bonuses: we know that talent attracts talent, and we encourage you to refer people you know to join our team
  • The opportunity to take ownership and responsibility, impacting the company’s growth in an international environment with 40+ nationalities
  • Employee Assistance Program

Productsup values diversity. We celebrate our differences and strive to learn from each other with the firm conviction that diversity drives innovation. Our commitment to equal opportunities begins at the hiring process and extends to our whole working culture. Everyone has a unique contribution to make and all are welcome.

The software that you and your team write will power the largest community of early career developers in the world and help redefine the future of work & technical education.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain features for our Rails-based platform serving 1M+ developers. You’ll design, write, and maintain the software that powers everything we do. You’ll be a part of the entire lifecycle from conception through deployment.

  • Shape Our Engineering Culture, Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering documentation. Your contributions will help shape a world-class engineering culture that values shipping high-quality software. You'll implement and benefit from industry best-practices including code reviews, pair programming, CI/CD, testing, and more.

  • Collaborate with product and design on feature specifications and technical approach

About Major League Hacking (MLH):
Major League Hacking (MLH) is rethinking technical education for the modern world. Now that every company is a technology company, we need faster and more effective ways to train the talent that everyone depends on. Our unique hands-on, community-driven approach has helped more than 1,000,000 technologists worldwide launch their careers and stay up-to-date with the latest trends. If you're passionate about technology, education, and the future of work – this is the place for you!

  • Our co-founders, Swift and Jon, were recognized for their work in education by Forbes in the 2017 30 Under 30 list.

  • We work with some of the top technology brands like Google, MongoDB, and Eleven Labs to help them reach our community and get the latest and greatest tools into their hands.

  • We have a group of world-class investors focused on technology and impacting technical education including General Catalyst, Alexis Ohanian (Reddit), Jeff Lawson (Twilio), Rethink Education, Jobs for the Future, and Reach Capital.

  • We are a mission driven Public Benefit Corporation, committed to responsibly serving the world and our community.

  • We are a globally distributed team.

Hacking is all about figuring out different solutions to problems, and showing how your experience might serve as a substitute for our requirements might be your first hack with us.

We serve a diverse community and perspectives of women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ people, and those with backgrounds typically not served by technology help us serve our community more deeply. We strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other marginalized communities.

  • Experience building and maintaining production Rails applications at scale

  • Strong understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred)

  • Proficiency with modern JavaScript/React

  • Experience with Git workflows and code review practices

  • Proven ability to work independently in remote/distributed teams

  • Strong experience in TDD and modern development practices

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong self-direction and ability to manage deliverables independently

  • An interest in reimagining the future of education and work. Direct experience/familiarity with MLH’s community is a plus.

  • 40 hours per week full time contract, ₹1500000-2600000 INR/annually

  • Flexible hours with 2-4 hour overlap with US Eastern Time for team syncs (typically 9am-1pm EST)

jobs.description:
Help shape the future of healthcare at Luscii

🌍

Why this open position?

At Luscii, we don’t believe every meaningful role starts with a job description. We’re growing in multiple directions at once, and some of our most impactful collaborations have started with people who simply reached out and said: “I want to contribute here.”

This open application is for people who want to help improve healthcare through technology. Even if there isn’t a perfect vacancy matching their profile right now.

About Luscii

Luscii builds digital health solutions that enable healthcare professionals to monitor and guide patients remotely. Our platform is used by hospitals, healthcare organizations and patients across the world to deliver care that is more accessible, more proactive and more personal.

From chronic disease monitoring to hospital-at-home programmes, our goal is simple: creating space for care. And to make healthcare more human by making it smarter. We operate internationally, but we stay focused on simplicity, clinical impact, and reliability in everything we build.

Where you could contribute

We don’t assign predefined roles here. Instead, we look at where your skills, experience, and motivation could create value. Possible areas within Luscii include:

Product & Technology

  • Mobile development

  • Frontend, Backend, Fullstack & cloud engineering

  • Product management

  • UX / UI design

  • Data & analytics

Click here for more information about Engineering at Luscii.

Clinical & Healthcare Implementation

  • Clinical implementation specialists

  • Collaboration with hospitals and care teams

  • Designing and improving care pathways

Commercial & Growth

  • Healthcare partnerships (NL & international)

  • Business development

  • Marketing & communications

Operations & Support

  • Process improvement

  • Project & programme management

  • Operational support and service delivery

Legal, Privacy & Security

  • Privacy & GDPR compliance

  • Information security

  • Contracting and governance

How we work

Holacracy is our way to go. You might read more about it here or on the company website.

  • Small, multidisciplinary teams

  • Accountability and ownership

  • Close collaboration

  • Fast iteration, grounded in clinical responsibility

We move quickly and adapt. But never at the expense of patient safety or quality of care.

What we’re looking for

We’re not looking for a perfect cv or background. We’re looking for people who:

  • Want to make a real impact in healthcare

  • Take ownership and work independently

  • Are curious and eager to learn

  • Enjoy collaborating across disciplines

  • Believe digital healthcare can and should be better

Open application – how it works

If you feel connected to Luscii but don’t see a role that fits, we’d still like to hear from you.

Please send us:

  • Your cv or LinkedIn profile

  • A short motivation: where would you want to make an impact at Luscii?

What happens next?

We don’t assess open applications purely against current vacancies. Instead, we look at where your energy and strenghts lie and where you might or could create meaningful impact. Besides, we explore the match for either now or the (near) future if we do see any relevant potential roles or opportunities.

If there’s potential alignment, we’ll reach out for a conversation to explore the possibilities together.

Interested?

Send us your open application and tell us what you’d like to help build. We’re not just looking for profiles. We’re looking for perspectives.

Highlights

Don’t see a role on our website that matches your background, experience, or ambitions? We’d still love to hear from you, so feel free to send us an open application.

jobs.description:
About Us

Are you ready to build the future of the supply chain? At Gather AI, we’re not just creating software; we’re pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We’ve developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining “on-time, in full” delivery.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We’re leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.

About the Team

You’ll be part of our Engineering organization, working closely with our Full Stack and WMS integration teams. The group builds and operates the production systems behind Gather AI’s warehouse intelligence platform, including APIs, integrations, data pipelines, databases, and application services used by our customers and internal teams every day.

This is a small, distributed engineering team where engineers work across a broad technical surface area and have the opportunity to see their work through the full software development lifecycle, from design and development through deployment, production monitoring, troubleshooting, and improvement.

About the Role

We are hiring an SDE II, Full Stack, for our India-based team. You'll build and run the web platforms behind Gather AI's products - Drone Vision, MHE Vision and SAGE, from the customer-facing dashboards down to the APIs, Integration layers and data pipelines that serve them.

This is a fully remote, hands-on engineering role for someone early in their career who already has experience building production software and wants broader ownership. You’ll work alongside senior engineers, taking on well-scoped features, integrations, and platform improvements while developing deeper expertise across APIs, backend services, databases, distributed systems, infrastructure, and production reliability.

You won’t be limited to writing code against someone else’s design. You’ll contribute to technical decisions, troubleshoot systems in production, work through failures and performance issues, and gradually take ownership of components from development through deployment and ongoing support.

Because our team is distributed across multiple time zones, clear written communication, initiative, and the ability to make progress independently are especially important.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain production backend services using Python and Node.js/NestJS
  • Design, build, and maintain REST APIs and integrations with internal and external systems
  • Work with PostgreSQL in production, including schema design, complex queries, indexing, connection management, and performance tuning
  • Build and support asynchronous workflows using message queues and distributed system patterns
  • Apply caching strategies across application and data layers, including understanding cache invalidation and performance tradeoffs
  • Take features and integrations through the full software development lifecycle, including development, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and iteration
  • Containerize and deploy services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Monitor production systems using logs, dashboards, metrics, and other observability tools to understand reliability, throughput, and performance
  • Diagnose and resolve production issues, including failures across APIs, integrations, queues, databases, and multi-service workflows
  • Contribute to secure development practices including authentication, authorization, secrets handling, and protection against common application vulnerabilities
  • Work closely with senior engineers on technical design and architecture decisions while progressively taking greater ownership
  • Identify opportunities to improve code, reliability, performance, engineering processes, and system design rather than only executing assigned work
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Security, Customer Success, Product, and other teams as our platform continues to scale

What You’ll Need

  • 2–5 years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production software
  • An engineering degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
  • Production experience with Python and Node.js/NestJS, with strong production depth in at least one and working experience with the other
  • Experience building production-grade APIs, microservices, or backend systems and seeing them through deployment and ongoing operation
  • Strong SQL fundamentals and hands-on relational database experience, including complex queries, indexing, schema design, and production performance troubleshooting
  • Experience designing and maintaining REST APIs, not only consuming them
  • Experience integrating with external systems and understanding real-world concerns such as retries, duplicate processing, failure handling, and unreliable dependencies
  • Working knowledge of distributed systems concepts including asynchronous processing, message queues, retries, consistency, and failure recovery
  • Understanding of caching, including what to cache, where caching should occur, and how invalidation is handled
  • Experience with message queues or asynchronous processing technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, or equivalent
  • Experience with Redis or another caching technology
  • Experience with Azure or another major cloud provider, deploying and debugging, using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with Git and modern code review workflows
  • Understanding of secure coding fundamentals including authentication and authorization, secrets handling, injection risks, and data exposure
  • Experience working with production systems beyond simply writing code, including monitoring metrics, investigating performance, responding to failures, and improving systems after issues occur
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to document decisions, explain tradeoffs, write clear PRs and design notes, and raise blockers early
  • A collaborative and curious approach, with the willingness to contribute ideas, ask questions, accept feedback, and work across component boundaries when needed

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or operating data pipelines, including handling failures, backfills, and data-quality issues
  • Familiarity with data engineering concepts such as warehouse or lakehouse modeling, dbt or equivalent, and ETL/ELT design
  • Experience with orchestration or streaming technologies such as Airflow, Flink, or similar
  • Familiarity with BI and visualization tools such as Metabase, Apache Superset, or equivalent
  • Experience with multi-region or geo-distributed systems
  • Experience in logistics, warehouse management systems, robotics, or another physical-world technology environment
  • Experience incorporating AI-assisted development into the software development lifecycle
  • Exposure to GenAI code-validation practices or engineering guardrails

jobs.description:
About Us

Hyperproof is on a mission to transform the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) world with a powerful new software platform. With Hyperproof, companies can save time and money while also operating their programs at a much higher level of effectiveness and accountability. We envision a world where organizations we depend on are truly trustworthy — and Hyperproof is the platform that will get them there.

We have a great team and culture — picture yourself in a highly collaborative startup environment where you can make a real impact on something truly important. It's an exciting time to be at Hyperproof; we raised our Series B round in 2023, validating our teamwork and company vision, and we continue to grow rapidly.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a talented Software Engineer to join our Risk Management team and help build first-party risk management features that help our customers identify, assess, and mitigate organizational risk.

Who You Are

You are a full-stack engineer with 3–5 years of experience who cares about building software that is correct, reliable, and genuinely useful. You thrive working across the stack — comfortable designing APIs in the morning and refining React components in the afternoon. You take pride in writing code that is well-tested and maintainable, and you understand that in a compliance domain, data integrity is not optional.

You are excited by the challenge of translating complex domain logic — risk scoring, control testing, framework alignment — into clean, intuitive product experiences. You are comfortable asking questions, engaging in design discussions, and owning features end-to-end. You work well in a collaborative, async-first environment.

What You Will Do

As a Software Engineer on the Risk Management team, your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, build, and ship first-party risk management features including risk register, inherent and residual risk scoring, and risk lifecycle workflows.
  • Develop and extend control testing and monitoring capabilities — automated evidence checks, test cadence scheduling, and pass/fail logic tied to compliance outcomes.
  • Build integrations with compliance frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and others — enabling customers to map their controls and risks to the standards that matter to them.
  • Collaborate with product managers and designers to translate compliance domain requirements into reliable, intuitive product experiences.
  • Write backend services and APIs in C# (.NET), Node.js, and/or Python that are performant, well-documented, and testable.
  • Build and maintain React/TypeScript front-end components that surface complex risk data in clean, actionable dashboards.
  • Participate in design reviews and code reviews, contributing to engineering quality across the team.
  • Work closely with QA to ensure correctness — you understand that in a compliance product, data integrity issues have real consequences for our customers.

What You Will Bring

Required:

  • 3–5 years of software engineering experience in a product-focused company.
  • Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript for front-end development.
  • Experience with at least one of Java Springboot, Node.js, or Python for back-end API development.
  • Comfort working across the full stack — you can own a feature from data model to UI.
  • Familiarity with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and writing efficient, well-structured queries.
  • Solid understanding of REST API design principles and asynchronous patterns.
  • A track record of writing well-tested code; you care about test coverage and the long-term cost of technical debt.
  • Excellent communication skills; you can engage effectively in async and cross-functional team environments.
  • A positive attitude and willingness to learn, adapt, and grow in a dynamic environment.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to GRC, compliance, audit, or risk management domains — even as an end user.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or FedRAMP.
  • Experience building workflow-heavy or state-machine-driven features.
  • Familiarity with risk registers, control frameworks, or evidence management concepts.
  • Prior experience in a B2B SaaS environment.

Location

We are a fully remote company! This role is open to candidates based in India. Rather than restrict ourselves to only finding talent in one city, we'd rather find the absolute best people regardless of where they live.

Where You'll Go

  • Hyperproof also loves to see an internal transfer. If a linear career path is not what you're looking for, you can work with your manager and our people team to explore lateral moves to other parts of the organization as you continue to grow with us.

Compensation

  • ₹2,137,000 - ₹3,000,000

WHERE YOU’LL GO

  • Hyperproof also loves to see an internal transfer. If a linear career path is not what you’re looking for, you can work with your manager and our people team to explore lateral moves to other parts of the organization as you continue to grow with us.

WHAT WE OFFER TO OUR EMPLOYEES

Please note: Benefits listed below are for employees in the United States; contractor roles or international positions may differ

  • Annual compensation reviews + equity
  • Unlimited PTO: strongly encouraged to unplug and recharge
  • Health: coverage for medical, dental, and vision - employee and dependents
  • 401K, which vests immediately, complete with a 4% company match
  • 12 weeks of Parental leave and 1 year free diapers and wipes with Honest
  • Annual company in-person events and quarterly in-person connects
  • $500 home office stipend - at the time of hire. Any additional home office needs are requested as needed.
  • $100 quarterly paid wellness stipend
  • Pet insurance discount
  • Slack channel notifications turn off after 5 pm based on your time zone
  • Two Hypercharge weeks of rest where we close company-wide (July & Dec)

It’s an exciting time to be at Hyperproof — we recently raised $40 million in our Series B financing, further cementing Hyperproof as the emerging leader in the risk and compliance management space.

At Hyperproof’s core are our passionate team members who focus on user experience, beautiful design, and evangelize a positive social impact of our cloud based platform. We help organizations streamline their risk and compliance workflows so our customers can spend more time strategically managing programs and less time wrangling spreadsheets.

We are disrupting the governance, risk, and compliance software space with our innovative platform by helping traditionally unsung heroes (compliance professionals) do the right things so the wrong things don’t happen.

Learn more about the @hyperproof culture and how it all started.

A NOTE ABOUT OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

We’re committed to creating a fair, respectful, and secure hiring experience for everyone. As part of that commitment, we use standard verification steps throughout our interview process.

Here’s what that means for you:

  • We may conduct routine verification checks during the hiring process.
  • You might be asked additional questions to better understand your experience and background.
  • For video interviews, we ask that candidates be on camera without filters or visual modifications.

These steps are applied consistently for all candidates and are designed to ensure an equitable experience for everyone.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Hyperproof is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace — it’s one of our core values! Hyperproof is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

To ensure a smooth interview process, all candidates will be required to provide a valid phone number that is not a VOIP (Voice Over Internet Protocol) number. This helps us maintain clear and reliable communication throughout your interview experience.

Ads, together with DART and margin calculators, is a critical input into day-to-day Merchant decisions. The current Ads experience is one of the least-used areas in Brand Experience because it does not yet provide essential data, including keyword-level detail, or a compelling explanation of performance. This engineer will help overhaul that experience, support rapid proofs of concept, and build scalable capabilities that contribute to Merchandising's goal in additional programmatic Brand support across Ads, Promotions, and Pricing Support.

What Success Looks Like

    • Delivers a significantly improved Ads experience in Brand Experience and Merchant Station, increasing engagement with a page that currently has the lowest usage on the platform.

    • Provides Merchants and Brands with accurate, decision-ready advertising data, including keyword-level performance insights.

    • Enables Merchants to audit advertising spend, explain the impact of Project Astra, and present a clear story about Spreetail's advertising strategy and results.

    • Builds actionable recommendations that help Brands understand when and where additional advertising investment can create value.

    • Runs focused proofs of concept quickly, incorporates feedback, and scales successful approaches into reliable product capabilities.

    • Contributes to Merchandising's goal of securing $1 million in additional programmatic Brand support across Ads, Promotions, and Pricing Support.

    • Improves the reliability, clarity, and usability of advertising data across both internal and Brand-facing workflows.

Key Responsibilities

    Design, build, test, and maintain full-stack features for Ads across Brand Experience and Merchant Station.

    • Develop data services and visualizations that show advertising performance, spend, impact, and opportunities for action.

    • Translate advertising strategy, Project Astra outputs, and complex business rules into clear product experiences for Merchants and Brands.

    • Create keyword-level and other detailed views needed to diagnose performance and support investment decisions.

    • Integrate advertising data into existing Merch Tech workflows while maintaining accuracy, freshness, and consistency.

    • Partner with Merchants, Product, Design, Data, and engineering teammates to clarify user needs and prioritize the highest-value capabilities.

    • Develop proofs of concept to test how Ads insights and storytelling can increase Brand engagement and support dollars.

    • Improve deployment workflows so new data, metrics, and product enhancements can reach users faster and more safely.

    • Apply strong engineering practices, including code reviews, automated testing, monitoring, documentation, and maintainable system design.

    • Investigate production issues, resolve data or experience gaps, and continuously improve platform performance and usability.

Key Metrics You Will Impact

    • Engagement and adoption of Ads capabilities in Brand Experience and Merchant Station.

    • Availability and completeness of decision-critical Ads data, including keyword-level information.

    • Merchant ability to audit advertising spend and communicate advertising performance to Brands.

    • Speed and quality of proofs of concept, experiments, and subsequent production releases.

    • Contribution toward $1 million in additional programmatic Brand support across Ads, Promotions, and Pricing Support.

    • Data accuracy, platform reliability, defect rates, and time to resolve issues.

    • Cycle time for introducing new Ads data, insights, and user actions into the platforms.

Skills and Experience

    • Strong 3-5 years of full-stack development skills, with experience connecting backend data services to intuitive front-end experiences.

    • Experience developing analytics, reporting, or data-visualization products that help users make decisions.

    • Ability to translate complex business logic and large datasets into accurate, understandable, and actionable product features.

    • Experience working with APIs, data integrations, data quality checks, and modern software delivery practices.

    • Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, monitoring, and maintainable system design.

    • Comfort working in ambiguity, testing ideas quickly, learning from users, and iterating toward scalable solutions.

    • Clear communication and effective collaboration with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • Experience with e-commerce, pricing, promotions, or merchant-facing platforms is preferred.

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Software Development Engineer II (Full Stack) to join our Agency Module, Platform Billing, and Onboarding team. These products form a critical part of HighLevel’s Agency ecosystem, enabling agencies to seamlessly create and manage their accounts, onboard onto the platform, manage subscriptions and billing, and scale their businesses.

Today, 100K+ agencies use HighLevel, collectively serving 2M+ businesses of all sizes, primarily SMBs. The systems we build support critical parts of the agency lifecycle and directly contribute to agency growth by making onboarding, account management, and billing experiences reliable and seamless.

The team builds and scales key capabilities across Agency Signup and Company Management, Platform Billing, and Agency Onboarding. Our onboarding experiences help new agencies get started with HighLevel, configure their accounts, discover and adopt key platform capabilities, and move from signup to successfully using the platform. Together, these systems provide the foundation for agencies to onboard, operate, and grow their businesses on HighLevel.

As an SDE-2, you’ll work across the frontend and backend, building and delivering features across these systems. You’ll work on scalable APIs and services, data-driven workflows, integrations, and modern frontend experiences while developing a strong understanding of the products and systems you work on.

You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers to take features from requirements through implementation and production, contribute to technical discussions, and continuously improve the quality and reliability of the systems you work on.

Responsibilities

  • Build and deliver features across the Agency Module, Agency Onboarding, and Platform Billing, contributing across both backend and frontend systems.

  • Design and build scalable backend services, APIs, and integrations, working across internal microservices and third-party platforms such as Stripe, with a focus on reliability, security, and performance.

  • Build performant and scalable frontend experiences for agency management, onboarding, and billing workflows using modern frontend frameworks and component-driven architecture with strong state management practices.

  • Own features end-to-end, from understanding requirements and technical planning through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.

  • Leverage AI-first coding practices and AI tools (such as LLMs, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) to write, refactor, test, and debug code efficiently, while maintaining strict guardrails for reliability and security.

  • Design data models and build efficient queries across data stores such as MongoDB, ClickHouse, and Elasticsearch.

  • Participate across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from requirement analysis and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and production support.

  • Write clean, efficient, secure, and testable code with appropriate unit and integration test coverage.

  • Use logs, metrics, monitoring, and tracing to troubleshoot production issues and contribute to improving system reliability.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, incident resolution, and operational support, including on-call responsibilities where applicable.

  • Follow engineering best practices around security, scalability, maintainability, testing, documentation, and production readiness.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production-grade full-stack applications.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and TypeScript for backend development, including APIs and service integrations; NestJS experience is preferred.

  • Strong frontend development experience with Vue.js, React, or Angular, with Vue.js preferred, and a good understanding of component-based development and state management.

  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with microservices and service-to-service integrations.

  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB or similar databases, including data modeling, querying, and performance considerations.

  • Experience with asynchronous and event-driven application patterns, using technologies such as GCP Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar.

  • Ability to debug and troubleshoot production issues across frontend, backend, databases, and integrations using logs and monitoring tools.

  • Good understanding of software engineering practices including automated testing, code reviews, Git, CI/CD, and production deployment.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and the ability to use them effectively as part of day-to-day engineering workflows.

  • Strong problem-solving, ownership, and collaboration skills, with the ability to independently take a feature from requirement understanding through implementation and production.

Preferred Experience

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.
jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.


At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.


Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


Why this role matters

The Innovations team at Genesys builds AI-powered applications and agents on top of Genesys Cloud, delivering them to enterprise customers through AppFoundry. These solutions include industry-specific agents, compliance-focused capabilities, and platform integrations that help organizations orchestrate customer experiences at scale. Operating with the speed and mindset of a product studio, the team focuses on turning emerging AI capabilities into practical, production-ready solutions for real customer needs.

This role is critical to that mission. We are looking for a full-stack engineer who is excited to build AI applications that solve meaningful customer experience challenges. You will work across the stack from modern React frontends to backend services and LLM integrations, to design and deliver solutions that are scalable, usable, and enterprise ready.

ABOUT GENESYS

Genesys powers customer experiences for organizations around the world. Genesys Cloud helps enterprises orchestrate omnichannel journeys, modernize service operations, and deliver differentiated customer and employee experiences at scale.

Genesys Innovations builds applications, accelerators, and integration-led solutions that help customers unlock more value from their Genesys platforms through AI, analytics, automation, and modern cloud engineering.

ROLE SUMMARY

We are looking for a principal-level builder to architect, build, and operate secure, scalable, cloud-native applications on AWS. The role spans React and TypeScript front ends, Node.js and Python services, APIs, event-driven integrations, data flows, and production operations.

You will also help shape AI-enabled product capabilities such as intelligent assistants, search, summarization, recommendations, workflow automation, and agentic user experiences. Success in this role requires strong engineering judgment across reliability, security, latency, cost, observability, and maintainability.

This is not a pure people-management role. We are looking for someone who enjoys moving between architecture, implementation, design reviews, technical leadership, and production problem solving.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

· Lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and delivery of full stack applications and platform components across UI, backend services, integrations, data, and cloud infrastructure.

· Stay deeply hands-on in implementation, prototyping, code reviews, debugging, and design validation.

· Build secure, scalable APIs, microservices, event-driven workflows, and responsive user experiences on AWS.

· Design and deliver AI-enabled and agentic capabilities using patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool and action invocation, workflow orchestration, context management, evaluation, and guardrails where appropriate.

· Integrate applications with Genesys platforms and with customer enterprise systems using APIs, SDKs, middleware, data pipelines, and event streams.

· Define and enforce engineering standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, performance, documentation, and operational readiness.

· Codify reusable assets such as libraries, components, prompts, templates, accelerators, and reference patterns that improve delivery speed across engagements.

· Use AI-assisted engineering tools and coding agents responsibly to accelerate implementation, testing, refactoring, documentation, and root-cause analysis; validate all AI-generated output before release.

· Partner with product, consulting, delivery, and customer stakeholders to turn business goals into scalable technical solutions and implementation roadmaps.

· Troubleshoot production issues, drive root-cause analysis, and implement durable fixes and telemetry improvements.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Principal engineering foundation

· 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building commercial applications, including experience leading technical direction for complex systems at senior, staff, or principal level.

· Strong hands-on full stack expertise with React, TypeScript or JavaScript, and Node.js, plus working proficiency in Python, Java, or a comparable backend language.

· Strong experience designing and delivering distributed systems, REST or GraphQL APIs, microservices, asynchronous services, and cloud-native architectures.

· Hands-on experience building with LLMs – tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval/RAG, evaluation. Production preferred, serious side projects count.

· Comfortable with agentic patterns: multi-step reasoning, autonomous tool use, structured planning, and the failure modes that come with giving an LLM real agency.

· Working familiarity with AWS, experience with Lambda, ECS/Fargate, Bedrock, or similar is a plus.

· Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, secure coding practices, release engineering, and production observability.

· Experience integrating with enterprise systems and data sources, including real-time and event-driven patterns.

· Ability to communicate clearly with engineers, architects, delivery leaders, and customer stakeholders in both technical and non-technical settings.

· Demonstrated success in customer-facing or consulting-style delivery environments where solution quality, speed, and pragmatism matter.

Agentic AI and GenAI delivery

· Recent hands-on experience building and shipping GenAI, LLM, or agentic applications in production enterprise environments.

· Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, prompt and workflow design, tool use or function calling, agent orchestration, evaluation, and guardrail patterns.

· Understanding of enterprise AI requirements such as observability, auditability, tenant isolation, RBAC, privacy, safety, and responsible use.

· Experience integrating model or AI services through Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent platforms and APIs.

· Familiarity with modern AI application frameworks or protocols such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, MCP, A2A, or equivalent approaches.

· Practical experience using AI coding assistants or coding agents such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent tooling to improve developer productivity with disciplined human review.

· Ability to evaluate AI solutions for correctness, latency, cost, reliability, maintainability, and measurable business value.

Preferred domain experience

· Experience in customer service, contact center, or CX domains, especially AI oriented systems like Sierra, Decagon, or Kore.AI

· Practical experience integrating with Genesys technologies, APIs, and SDKs such as PSDK, WFM API, IceLib, ICWS, GWS, or comparable patterns.

· Experience building real-time analytics, streaming applications, or RTA-style user experiences.

· Strong consulting and stakeholder management practices, including architecture notes, design specifications, user guides, and deployment documentation.

· Experience with database performance tuning and optimization.



Working at Genesys

  • AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.
  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.
  • Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support.
  • Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families.
  • Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work®certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.


What Happens After You Apply

After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:

  • Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team.
  • A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview. 
  • Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team.
  • We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases.
  • After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps.

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.


Stay Connected

Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.

jobs.description:
About Semaphore

Semaphore is a remote-first software company building continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) products for engineering teams. Our customers rely on Semaphore Cloud and our self-hosted enterprise products to build, test, and deliver software securely and reliably.

We have spent years building developer infrastructure at scale. We are now using that foundation to create new products and capabilities for a world in which software is increasingly built by people working with AI coding agents.

About the role

We are looking for a senior product engineer who can take an important idea from an early, ambiguous problem to a useful product running in production.

You will work across product and engineering boundaries: understanding the user, shaping the solution, making technical decisions, building the system, and improving it based on real use. Some work will extend mature Semaphore products. Some will start as a small experiment or a new product. In either case, you will be responsible for getting to a strong outcome, not completing a predefined list of tickets.

AI coding agents are part of our daily engineering workflow. We expect you to use them fluently to explore, build, test, and ship faster. You remain accountable for the work: choosing the right problem, setting direction, making trade-offs, reviewing what is produced, and ensuring that the result is coherent, reliable, and maintainable.

This role is for someone with strong ownership, initiative, taste, and judgment. You should be comfortable moving between product questions, system design, code, infrastructure, and user experience as the work requires.

What you will own

  • Take product ideas from problem definition through design, implementation, rollout, and iteration, including experiments that may grow into standalone products.
  • Work directly with users and internal stakeholders to identify the real problem, decide what is worth building, and make pragmatic scope and architecture decisions.
  • Build across backend services, APIs, infrastructure-facing components, and focused frontend experiences, reusing proven Semaphore systems before introducing new infrastructure.
  • Use AI coding agents effectively while maintaining a high bar for correctness, security, clarity, and product quality.
  • Own the production outcome, including reliability, observability, supportability, and working within Semaphore's security and compliance requirements. Communicate decisions, progress, and risks clearly.

What we are looking for

  • A track record of independently shipping meaningful software products or major product capabilities.
  • Strong product judgment: you can identify the essential user problem, reduce unnecessary scope, and recognize when an experience is good enough to ship—or not good enough yet.
  • Strong engineering judgment across system design, implementation, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Strong backend and systems fundamentals, including APIs, asynchronous processing, service boundaries, state and lifecycle management, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Comfort with infrastructure concepts such as virtual machines, storage, networking, authentication, secrets, containers, and cloud platforms.
  • Ability to navigate a polyglot environment. Semaphore systems include Go, Elixir, Ruby, React, and related technologies; expertise in every language is not required.
  • Enough frontend capability to build or extend focused product user experiences without depending on a separate team for every change.
  • Fluency with modern AI-assisted development: decomposing work for agents, supplying useful context, reviewing generated changes, and building verification into the workflow.
  • Initiative and persistence. You make progress with incomplete information, surface risks early, and bring in other people when their input will improve the result.
  • Strong written and spoken English and experience working independently in a remote, asynchronous team.

We care more about the quality and ownership of what you have built than a specific number of years, previous title, or exact match with our stack.

Nice to have

  • Experience building developer tools, CI/CD systems, cloud platforms, or infrastructure products.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed systems and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience evolving a mature codebase while introducing a new product or architecture alongside it.
  • Experience in a lean environment where senior engineers participate directly in product discovery and customer conversations.

What success looks like

Within your first three months:

  • You have taken ownership of a meaningful product problem and shipped a useful capability to production.
  • Your work shows good product taste, clear technical decisions, and disciplined scope.
  • You have learned enough of Semaphore's existing platform to reuse its strengths and avoid unnecessary reinvention.
  • You are using AI coding agents to increase your output while keeping the resulting systems understandable, tested, and reliable.
  • Product and engineering decisions move faster because you bring clear options, make sound calls, and follow through.
  • The team trusts you with an ambiguous new product or feature and expects you to drive it to a strong result.

How you will work

This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad ownership. You will work closely with engineering, product, infrastructure, and company leadership. Teams are small, communication is direct, and the person closest to the work is expected to exercise judgment.

You will have room to shape both the product and its implementation. In return, we expect you to take responsibility for the whole outcome: what gets built, why it matters, how well it works, and what happens after it ships.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description:B12's engineering team views software as a craft, but improving the world as the reason to practice it.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

B12's engineering team views software as a craft, but improving the world as the reason to practice it. Our engineers are responsible for prioritizing, conceptualizing, co-designing, building, testing, and engaging users for any concept we are building out. We’re generalists in encouraging each other to experience the full stack, but we’re also aware of each other’s preferences in the stack. For this role in particular, we’re searching for a tenured full-stack engineer who brings strong backend/infrastructure skills (and an interest in using them) to the product. We mentor and teach where we can, both inside and outside of the company, and as a Staff Software Engineer, you will be responsible not only for your ownership of major projects, but also mentorship of the team members with whom you ship those projects.

We value sharing our work with the outside world. Our team has published papers on forming expert flash teams and machine-mediated worker hierarchies. We’ve baked our research into various open source tools in the space of creativity, expertise, and knowledge work.

We hope our engineers have more longevity than any one tool we use, but here is a sampling of our current thoughts about technology:

  • We live on Python/Django and TypeScript/React.
  • We store blobs in Amazon’s S3, munch on them in Amazon’s EC2, develop in Docker, and deploy containers to Amazon’s Elastic Beanstalk.
  • We believe PostgreSQL should be the first system you consider when thinking about persisting structured data.
  • We clean and centralize data in Amazon’s Redshift, and are able to answer almost any question in SQL.
  • We leverage AI in our product and our internal tooling, and faced with a landscape in constant flux, try to pick the right model or agent on a task-by-task basis.
  • Our new code is almost 100% LLM-generated, and we’ve thought hard about ensuring quality in the face of ever-increasing review loads, what processes humans are still best at, and how the practice of mentorship must adapt in the face of these new tools.
  • We have near-full test coverage on the backend, and are making progress on our frontend and integration tests.
  • We set up continuous integration and deployment because, while this model comes with its own pains, we’ve disliked being on fixed release schedules on previous projects.
  • We like to move fast and support point-in-time recovery :).

You’d be a good fit if

  • You have 10 or more years of experience building products and systems in production.
  • You are an amazing communicator.
  • You feel comfortable managing your time and deciding among competing priorities.
  • You are curious.
  • You have a high ownership mentality.
  • You enjoy learning and teaching.
  • You are comfortable working with backend and frontend technologies, but have a deeper background and interest on the backend/infrastructure side.
  • You care about and want to contribute to our mission of helping people do meaningful work.

What does a staff engineer do here?

This is B12’s first Staff Engineer hire on a ~10-person product team that includes a designer, product manager, and CTO. To understand what we’re looking for in someone with this much experience, here are some concrete examples of tasks you’d work on in a month:

  • Own the delivery of a project of the magnitude “we ship one or two of these a quarter,” both individually shipping code and rallying and supporting team members in doing so.
  • Participate in quarterly planning to identify key projects to work on next quarter.
  • Mentor other engineers who are in the planning, prototyping, or implementation phases of a project.
  • Respond to an incident, write up a postmortem, and improve tooling and infrastructure to help us prevent or more quickly respond to the issue and others like it in the future.
  • Identify and optimize some infrastructure that costs too much, is too slow, or isn’t stable enough.
  • Discuss an early design/prototype with a designer or product manager to help shape its direction and explain what will be easy or hard to implement.
  • Unblock an operational team member on a data analysis project that answers a hairy question facing our business.
  • Run a brainstorm with engineers to identify how we might work more effectively or ship with a higher level of quality.

Don’t fear:

  • We highly favor talent and interest.
  • Some candidates may see this list and feel discouraged because they don’t match all the items. Please apply anyway: there’s a good chance you’re more wonderful than you think you are.
  • B12 is a safe place for human beings. We particularly encourage you to apply if you identify as a woman, are a person of color or other underrepresented minority, or are a member of the LGBTQIA community.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role:

As a Staff Full Stack Engineer (Backend Focus), you will build and operate the backend of a Web Analytics and AI portal. That includes the APIs that serve the application, the read data layer over analytical data, authentication and authorization, and the integration points with the services the rest of the team builds. The portal gives commercial intelligence to the people who make business decisions, through daily briefings, customizable KPIs, analytical insights, geographic exploration, and conversational analytics.

This is a Staff (L6), hands-on individual contributor role on a lean team where everyone is Staff: a Staff Architect, Staff AI Engineers, Staff Software Engineers, and Data Engineers. Architectural direction sits with the Staff Architect, and the AI Engineers own the agents. You are the builder: you take features from the design doc to production, end to end, and you make them fast, observable, and reliable. Most of your time goes to writing, reviewing, and operating code, including the user interface when the delivery calls for it.

What you'll do:

Build the backend and ship features end to end

  • Design, implement, test, and operate backend services against explicit latency, availability, and cost targets.
  • Implement typed, versioned API contracts and evolve them without breaking clients.
  • Own authentication, authorization, and multi-tenant access control across the portal.
  • Ship features end to end, from the API to the interface, when the delivery calls for it.
  • Integrate the application with internal services, including the agent services built by the AI Engineers. This covers response streaming, timeouts, cancellation, and partial failures.

Own the read path and performance

  • Own the read path over analytical data: data modeling, query plans, pagination, batching, caching, and consistency trade-offs.
  • Set and defend performance budgets. Profile services, reduce tail latency (p95, p99), and optimize cost per request.
  • Run load and capacity tests before launches, and use the results to make design decisions.

Make systems observable and reliable

  • Instrument services with metrics, structured logs, and distributed tracing from day one.
  • Define SLIs and SLOs, alerts, and dashboards for the components you own, and take part in on-call.
  • Diagnose and fix reliability issues, and lead incident response and blameless postmortems.
  • Establish safe rollout practices: feature flags, canary releases, and fast rollback.

Design and raise the bar

  • Write design docs for the components you deliver, compare alternatives with data and prototypes, and escalate risk to the Staff Architect.
  • Raise the team's technical bar through code review, pairing, and standards for testing, observability, and safe rollout.
  • Use coding agent harnesses such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex as part of your workflow, and review generated code against tests, types, and contracts.

What you'll need:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or another quantitative field. A master's degree or PhD is a plus.
  • Relevant experience designing, building, and operating distributed backend services in production, across coding standards, code review, build, automated testing, deployment, and operations.
  • A track record of building features end-to-end and owning them in production.
  • Relevant experience in software design for reliability and scale, on both new and existing systems.
  • Deep command of at least one high-performance language, such as Java/Kotlin, Go, Rust, C++, or C#, including its memory model, concurrency model, and runtime.
  • Ability to work productively in Python, the language of the current services.
  • Hands-on experience with observability in production: metrics, tracing, logging, SLOs, and tools such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus.
  • Proven experience with performance work: profiling, query optimization, caching strategies, and load testing.
  • Production depth in distributed systems: timeouts, retries, idempotency, partial failure, streaming (SSE, WebSockets), and decisions based on tail latency (p95, p99).
  • Relevant experience delivering full stack to production with TypeScript and a modern web framework.
  • Day-to-day fluency with coding agent harnesses such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex, including critical review of generated code.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to discuss architecture and trade-offs in depth.
  • Advanced communication in English; Spanish is a plus.

Nice to have:

  • Experience integrating applications with LLM or agent services as a consumer.
  • Experience with B2B, multi-country, or multi-tenant products.
  • Experience with cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP), containers, and Kubernetes.

More about you:

Digital Forms is a consulting-led digital transformation firm, founded in Warsaw in 2015 and now 70+ people strong. We work with mid-market and enterprise clients across Europe, the UK, and the US — helping them turn operational complexity into measurable business outcomes. We started as a mobile development shop. Over ten years, we built something different: a firm where every product is grounded in a real business case, and where engineering quality is as important as strategy. Our team is fully remote, our clients are international, and our standards are high.

This role sits at the heart of that delivery.

As Senior Mobile Developer, you will be embedded in a high-stakes client engagement - building a greenfield mobile app for a premium international luxury retail brand, from the first architectural decision to launch.

The role and responsibilities:

We are building a brand-new iOS and Android app — from scratch — as part of a major digital transformation for a premium international luxury retail brand. The app will serve 250k+ daily active users across global markets from the moment it launches.

The product replaces static navigation with a dynamic, content-driven Feed ecosystem: personalised brand stories, exclusive offers, and live in-store updates, delivered with the engagement depth of social media. It is a greenfield project — no legacy code, no technical debt, full architectural ownership from day one. The app goes live in Q3.

As Senior Mobile Developer, you will own the architecture and delivery of the app end to end. You will write code every day — this is a pure hands-on engineering role, with no team management responsibility. The client expects senior autonomy from the start. You will work alongside a senior cross-functional team: backend engineers, frontend web developers, UI/UX designers, and a PM.

Architecture & technical leadership

  • Architect from scratch: Design the React Native app structure, patterns, and coding standards that the entire project will build on.

  • Define the content model: Work alongside FE Web developers to design the mobile content model powering dynamic, segmented delivery.

  • Drive technical decisions: Own integration choices for CMS, DAM, and personalisation tooling — and be able to defend them.

Feature development & integrations

  • Integrate CMS, DAM & personalisation: Connect the tooling that delivers the right content to the right user — context-aware, segmented, and real-time.

  • Implement deep linking: Build campaign-tied navigation flows and personalised user journeys across iOS and Android.

  • Ship push notifications: Design and implement the full push notification layer, including deep links and campaign landing flows.

  • Collaborate on features: Build and maintain new features together with backend engineers; work with UI/UX designers to assess feasibility and deliver high-quality UX.

Performance & quality

  • Optimise for scale: Own caching strategy, content-fetching architecture, and rendering performance for an app used by hundreds of thousands of people daily.

  • Instrument analytics: Implement event tracking that supports personalisation decisions, A/B testing, and experimentation.

  • Write quality code: Idiomatic, well-tested React Native — unit and component coverage as standard practice.

  • Own distribution: Manage iOS and Android release cycles and store submissions.

Requirements

Must-have:

  • React Native — 5+ years of professional experience building production iOS and Android apps from scratch.

  • iOS and Android platforms — both, including distribution cycles, store submissions, and platform-specific behaviour.

  • CMS & DAM integration — hands-on experience delivering dynamic, segmented content in mobile via headless CMS and DAM tooling.

  • Personalisation & experimentation platforms — integrating decisioning tools, recommendation engines, or A/B testing systems into a live mobile product.

  • Deep linking — production experience implementing campaign and personalised navigation flows.

  • Push notifications — full implementation including deep links and campaign flows.

  • REST API integration — connecting mobile apps to backend services at production scale.

  • Performance optimisation — caching, content-fetching, and rendering strategies for personalised, high-traffic apps.

  • Analytics & event tracking — instrumentation supporting personalisation and product experimentation.

  • Testable code — appropriate unit and component test coverage as standard practice.

  • English C1+ — written and spoken; direct communication with an international client team is a hard requirement.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with streaming APIs or AI-assisted feature integration.

  • App analytics platforms such as Firebase or Amplitude.

  • Consent management and third-party privacy tooling (GDPR).

  • Mapping SDKs — Google Maps, Mapbox, or similar.

  • Automated testing beyond unit and component level (E2E, integration).

  • Broader JS ecosystem: , React, .

  • A/B testing, feature flagging, and mobile attribution.

  • Headless CMS architectures in retail or e-commerce environments.

  • Understanding of UI/UX design principles and ability to assess feasibility.

  • Polish is a plus; all project communication is conducted in English.

Highlights

Build a brand-new mobile app for a premium luxury retail brand, used by 250k+ daily users.

Own the full architecture — React Native, CMS, DAM, personalisation — from day one.
